question: What is declared to be the clear body of the power of action?
premises: The mutual diversity of powers has been described.
This diversity manifests as the power of action.
It becomes clear in a triadic abode.
inference: The clear body of the power of action is the manifest triadic diversity of the powers.
uncertainties: The 'fourteenth abode' is a technical reference not explained in this verse.
plain_english: They declare this very diversity to be the supreme, clear body of the power of action, in that fourteenth abode where the three powers have become manifest.
